properties.name: awskotlin.secrets-manager.enabled
properties.description: Whether Secrets Manager auto-configuration is enabled.

properties.name: awskotlin.secrets-manager.endpoint
properties.description: Override the Secrets Manager endpoint URL (for example, a LocalStack endpoint). Falls back to awskotlin.endpoint.

properties.name: awskotlin.secrets-manager.region
properties.description: Override the Secrets Manager region. Falls back to awskotlin.region, then the SDK default region chain.
